sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown with a reddish tinge; antennae uniformly coloured, only very slightly darker at the apex; labrum yellowish brown, transparent at the apex; mandibles dark brown, reddish brown at the base; pronotum yellowish brown; legs and abdomen pale yellowish white. Pilosity sparse on the head, denser on the pronotum than on the head. Head subrectangular, sides weakly convex; 1.96–2.39 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.73–2.00 mm maximum width; width of mandible base 1.06–1.26 mm; ratio of maximum width to head length 0.837; ratio of mandible-base width to maximum width 0.681. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Labrum triangular, apex pointed and transparent, each side with a row of setae and several minute hairs. Mandibles long and stout, slightly incurved near the tip. Left mandible with a large forwardly directed tooth slightly below the middle; left mandible 1.19–1.35 mm long; ratio of mandible length to head length 0.57. Right mandible with a small tooth, almost level with the left mandibular tooth. Postmentum subrectangular, sides nearly parallel; 1.28–1.58 mm long, 0.64–0.80 mm maximum width. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin weakly concave at the middle; posterior margin distinctly emarginate; 0.60–0.77 mm long, 1.25–1.33 mm wide.
